doc.title: Wendell Harrison interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, November 10, 2022 [interview 1 of 2]

title: Max Roach, Sun Ra, Horace Silver and playing freer
summary: Asked about Max Roach's quote, Harrison says Sun Ra and Coltrane influenced him more, and notes Horace Silver's publishing business.

story.theme_name: Playing with Coltrane and the avant-garde

blocks.x: I’d like to get at an issue and start with a quote. The issue is the role of jazz in society and how society affects jazz. And this is a quote from Max Roach that was connected to the “We Insist Freedom Now” LP, it was 1962. And he said “We American jazz musicians of African descent have proved beyond all doubt that we’re master musicians of our instruments. Now what we have to do is employ our skill to tell the dramatic story of our people and what we’ve been through.” So my question to you is did that music like Max Roach’s affect you and did you feel that it was a direction you wanted to go in or felt compelled to go in?

I admired Max. Sun Ra was more influential in terms of he affected my direction more than Max. Trane did. I liked Mingus but everybody was doing the same — had the same purpose but different ways of approaching to try to play freer, trying to play freer. And this meant, in terms of changing the format, like for instance Horace Silver, he’d just play — Horace Silver was very popular. He was a business guy. And he’d play and wrote tunes that sold. He had his own publishing — he was one of the first black musicians that had his own publishing company. And he was more interested in selling his music to the popular players in the world. Max or Trane, for instance Trane, Trane was more academic in terms of projecting the spiritual ideas and the reflection of pain and suffering of the community and bringing attention to these events that was happening down south like Alabama, Mississippi and Georgia and whatnot, bringing the events. He was telling the musical story of what was happening. And that kind of like influenced me you know.
